field.label: Send WhatsApp messages
field.comment: The master switch. Set it to No and this module stops sending anything at all, without losing your key, your numbers or your wording. Orders carry on exactly as before.

field.label: API key
field.comment: Create one in the Njiwa console under API keys. A key beginning sk_test_ checks and stores every message and delivers nothing, which is what you want while you set this up. A key beginning sk_live_ sends to real phones. The console shows a key once and keeps only its fingerprint, so a lost key is replaced rather than recovered. Magento stores it encrypted.

field.label: Njiwa address
field.comment: Leave this exactly as it is. It exists for shops that have been given their own Njiwa address, and changing it otherwise stops messages reaching anybody.

field.label: Send from
field.comment: Which of your linked WhatsApp numbers these messages come from. Digits only, in full international form, such as 254712345678. Leave it empty to use the number marked default in the console, which is the right answer if you have one number.

field.label: Check it works
field.comment: Asks Njiwa which numbers this key can send from, and says so plainly if it is a test key. It sends nothing. Both buttons use the settings as they are saved, not as they are on screen, so save first and then check.

field.label: Send a test message
field.comment: Sends one fixed message to the number you type here. Put in your own number: on a live key this is a real message to a real phone. The wording is fixed, so nothing you type here reaches anybody but you.

group.label: Messages to your customers
group.comment: Each message is plain text. Anything in braces is filled in from the order: {first_name}, {last_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}, {order_total}, {order_date}, {order_status}, {payment_method}, {items}, {item_count}, {shop_name}. A placeholder that does not exist is removed before sending rather than posted to a customer.

field.label: Order placed
field.comment: Sent the moment the order is placed, before any payment has been confirmed. Useful for bank transfer and cash on delivery.

field.label: Wording
field.comment: Leave this empty and nothing is sent, whatever the switch above says.

field.label: Payment received
field.comment: Sent when an invoice is paid. The one most shops want.

field.label: Order shipped
field.comment: Sent when a shipment is created, which is the moment the customer most wants to hear from you.

field.label: Order cancelled
field.comment: Worth sending. A cancellation nobody explained is what turns into a phone call.

field.label: Order refunded
field.comment: Sent when a credit memo is created. Saying the money is on its way stops the "where is my refund" message before it is sent.

group.label: The message to you
group.comment: One message when an order is placed, to your own number.

field.label: Tell me about new orders
field.comment: Send me a WhatsApp message when an order comes in.

field.label: Your WhatsApp numbers
field.comment: Where that message goes. Digits only, in full international form, separated by commas if there are several. Everybody listed gets their own copy.
